items.item: Each row shows the user's name and email, role, status in words (such as Active, Invited, Deactivated, Locked) and whether two-factor sign-in is enabled
items.evidence: Row markup (page.html lines 293-298) renders name, mailto email, u.role, and STATUS_LABEL text ("Hoạt động"/"Đang chờ xác nhận"/"Đã khóa") but there is no field or column for two-factor/MFA status anywhere in the data model (users array, lines 179-189) or row template.

items.item: Last sign-in uses one date-time format with the timezone stated, relative times also expose the exact time, and an account that has never signed in shows "Never" rather than a blank or a 1970 date
items.evidence: formatDateTime (line 146-149) formats with TIME_ZONE='Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' internally and renders e.g. "06/11/2026 08:10 · Hôm qua" (exact time + relative, good), and no-login users show "Chưa đăng nhập" (Never) — but the timezone itself is never shown in the UI (no offset/abbreviation label such as GMT+7/ICT anywhere in the row or header).

items.item: Users can be found by searching name or email and filtered by role, status and inactivity (such as no sign-in for 90+ days), with the number of matching users shown
items.evidence: input#q searches name+email (foldVi match, line 206), select#f-role filters role, status tabs (#tabs) filter status, and #result-count shows match count (line 52/258) — but there is no inactivity/no-sign-in-90-days filter anywhere in ui state or matching() (lines 197-207).

items.item: The invite form requires an email and a role, labels both fields, and shows an inline error for a malformed address or one that already has an account
items.evidence: label[for=invite-email]/label[for=invite-role] (lines 123,128), required attrs, EMAIL_RE validation producing "Nhập một địa chỉ email hợp lệ." and duplicate check `users.some(u => u.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase())` producing "Email này đã có trong hệ thống." shown in #invite-email-error with role="alert" (lines 436-459).

items.item: Deactivation asks for confirmation that names the user and states the effect (active sessions ended, sign-in blocked, data kept), and a deactivated user is offered Reactivate instead
items.evidence: Confirm dialog title "Vô hiệu hóa tài khoản của ${u.name}?" names the user, and text states only "Họ sẽ không thể đăng nhập cho đến khi được kích hoạt lại" (sign-in blocked) — it never mentions ending active sessions or that data is kept (handleRowAction 'disable', lines 336-342). Reactivate equivalent ("Kích hoạt tài khoản") is offered for disabled users (line 247).

items.item: The signed-in administrator's own row is marked (such as "You") and cannot be deactivated or lose the admin role, and the last remaining administrator cannot be deactivated, with the disabled action explaining why
items.evidence: No current-user concept exists anywhere in the script (no "You" badge, no currentUser/self id), and rowActionsHtml (lines 241-251) returns identical reset/disable buttons for every active user regardless of role or admin count — no admin-protection logic at all.

items.item: Password reset sends a reset link to the user's email address, which the confirmation names, and the administrator never sees, sets or types the new password
items.evidence: handleRowAction 'reset': `announce("Đã gửi email đặt lại mật khẩu tới ${u.email}.")` (line 328) names the recipient email; no password input field exists anywhere in the invite or row UI.

items.item: Row actions are buttons or a keyboard-operable menu whose accessible names include the user (such as "Actions for Mai Nguyen"), and the outcome of an action is announced in an aria-live or role="status" region
items.evidence: Each action button has an aria-label naming the user, e.g. aria-label="Vô hiệu hóa tài khoản của ${u.name}" / "Đặt lại mật khẩu cho ${u.name}" (rowActionsHtml, lines 243-250); outcomes go through announce() into #toast, which has role="status" aria-live="polite" (line 139).

items.item: A search with no matching users shows a message with a way to clear it, and loading and failed-load states with a retry exist
items.evidence: [data-state=empty] shows "Không có người dùng nào khớp với bộ lọc này" plus a "Xóa bộ lọc" button (#empty-action, lines 80-84); [data-state=loading] skeleton block and [data-state=error] alert with #retry button (lines 85-93) both exist as real DOM states (reachable via ?state=loading/error).

notes: Audit score 96/100 with only a 'table-row-two-line' warn (14/20 rows show exact-time + relative-time stacked in the last-login cell), which is expected given the exact+relative time requirement. No classic AI-dashboard template tells observed: no gradients, glass/blur, uppercase tracked labels, emoji icons, KPI tiles, greeting header, sidebar promo, or oversized radii (radii measured at 4-6px). One data oddity unrelated to the checklist: Ngô Thị Nga's duplicate row shows a last-login in the future ("sau 3 giờ nữa"), a mock-data generation quirk rather than a UI defect.
